title: Xlm95's Pvp Modpack
description: this modpack enhances your pvp and also gives you hidden advanteges in pvp, it can also optimize your game to increase your fps, some of these mods are banned in tier testing so take care
body:
Designed for competition, this modpack is aimed at providing the highest possible performance level as well as optimizing the PvP gameplay.

Being equipped with efficient optimization tools, visual tweaks that do not harm the performance and other features designed specifically for battles, this pack provides a lightweight and competitive experience.

No matter whether you are engaged in duels, faction fights or are just conquering PvP servers, you will get an optimized game from this pack, allowing you to concentrate solely on your victories.

The Mod Features:

High FPS and low latency gameplay
PvP optimized
Lightweight and performance oriented
Increased responsiveness and stability
No distractions, only competitiveness
